title: Register: from slang to officialese
description: The same message in informal, neutral and official Polish.

blocks.text: Polish marks register clearly. Informal speech among friends uses ty, short forms and colloquial words: siema (hi), spoko (fine, no worries), nara (bye). Neutral Polish uses standard vocabulary and pan or pani with strangers. Official Polish prefers verbal nouns, impersonal forms and formal connectors: iż instead of że, ponadto instead of poza tym, zatem instead of więc. Choosing the wrong register is noticed immediately, so match the person and the situation.
Dzień dobry, czy mogę w czymś pomóc?
blocks.translation: Good morning, can I help you with anything?

blocks.text: Uprzejmie informujemy, iż sklep będzie nieczynny w sobotę.
blocks.translation: Please be advised that the shop will be closed on Saturday.

blocks.text: Ponadto należy dołączyć kopię dowodu osobistego.
blocks.translation: Furthermore, a copy of your identity card must be attached.
